Four-region order: Rito Village (easiest to pick up; Tulin's wind ability is very useful) → Zora's Domain (water region; Sidon's water bubble shield is very strong) → Goron City (Yunobo's rolling technique can break rock, handy for mining) → Gerudo (Riju's lightning arrows pair powerfully with a bow).
